decision_reason: Completed: pre-registered WP1 substitution experiment ran through the harness (47.6 min, 1948 dataset episodes, 320 supervised estimator runs, 82032 paired validation/C3/L4 episodes); first attempt stopped at the pre-registered dataset leak gate (delay cells linear OOF R^2 0.125-0.300, archived wp1_full_leakstop1) and the single pre-authorized data iteration (mu-free multi-sine speed schedule) re-passed all gates; re-measured matched prizes positive in all 4 eligible cells (0.117-0.483, Newcombe CIs excluding 0) but the primary L3_GRU arm passes 0 of 4 cells (bar 3): only delay12 shows a significant paired gain (+0.185, one-sided 97.5 lower bound +0.110, recapture 0.38 < 0.5) while injection is net-negative elsewhere (substitution-time mu error 0.14-0.26 vs dataset-val MAE 0.02-0.14, behavior-policy shift plus reveal-tick override of the internal detector); estimator-level signal is strongly history-borne (GRU R^2 0.91-0.99 in delay cells, equal-capacity window arms at predict-mean, reset control destroys it); C3 condition not met (constant-mu handover floor captures the reaction-only prize, true-mu oracle 3-5 pp BELOW const0.7 floor, C3-trained estimators flat) so the FIR-vs-IIR readout is not reported; L0 leak route not triggered; L4 exploratory block supports class-prior-shortens-prefix (1s+prior 0.556 vs 5s uniform 0.625 vs nominal 0.250, n=72, descriptive); auxiliary measurement only with the engineering incumbent unchanged and no validation ranking promotion driver-performance current-sim high-fidelity full-driver repair-success robustness-result feasibility-proof or self-ID claim.

criteria, seeds, cells, or construction constants altered after the full run started

hypothesis: A pre-registered modular-belief substitution experiment on family #1 (M3215 G-A fallback routing) -- capacity/compute-matched supervised mu estimators (L0 current-frame, L2 windows 25/50/100, L3 GRU primary) trained on mu-decoupled prefix-carrying rollouts that pass the decision-frame leak gate, then injected at the decision tick into the SAME scripted seeker against a re-measured belief-free floor and matched per-mu oracle on 12 mu x 20 disjoint validation seeds per eligible cell with episode-paired differences and two-way (episode + training-seed cluster) uncertainty -- can decide the G-B learning gate (primary: L3_GRU recaptures at least 50 percent of the re-measured matched prize in at least 3 of the 4 frozen eligible cells with one-sided 97.5 percent lower bounds excluding 0) and the conditional C3 FIR-vs-IIR readout on the excitation-gap variant, before any validation ranking promotion driver-performance current-sim high-fidelity full-driver repair-success robustness-result feasibility-proof or self-ID claim.
